text:
frank: quick sync 1 compact observability surface proposal for next quarter. goal: ship a low-cost dashboards + lightweight trace sampling + cost-delta alerts + simple error clustering. timeline: 5 weeks.

nina: love the goal. what's our strict MVP cut line?

frank: MVP cut line: anything that adds >2x infra load or needs new storage is out. we must reuse existing metrics/trace stores. UI scope minimal: 3 cards + drilldown.

ash: clarify trace approach: do we want head/tail sampling? will do sampling on the edge?

frank: edge sampling preferred. plan: baseline 1% at edge, head-sample for low latency (<50ms) not needed, tail-sample 100% if latency > 300ms or status >= 500. store only spans and a small trace context (no full payloads).

ravi: cost card questions: do we show model-level or route-level? also what's "cost-delta" threshold?

frank: route-level primary. model rollup as optional computed batch job. cost-delta alert: default 15% day-over-day for now; configurable per-customer.

jen: error clustering: basic stack-hash grouping + top 5 examples per cluster. no automatic RCA or blame links in MVP. oncall just needs signal + example traces.

ash: sampling policy draft:
```
edge_sampling: 0.01 # 1% baseline
tail_threshold_ms: 300
error_override: 1.0 # sample all errors
max_daily_traces_per_route: 2000
```

frank: good. also add per-customer sampling cap to avoid a single tenant blowing the budget.

ravi: launch criteria proposal:
- dashboards render for staging + 1 sandbox customer + 2 pilot customers (orca, lumen)
- tail traces surface in UI for the routes we mark as "hot"
- cost-delta alerts created and fire in test harness
- error clusters appear and include an example trace
- total extra request processing overhead < 4% (measured in staging)

nina: pilot ask: need two enterprise teams to opt-in for higher sampling (5%) for first 10 days so we can validate error/regression detection. orca agreed; lumen pending.

ash: risks:
- spikes if sampling rules misapplied or override leaked
- UI backend might hit query timeouts when many customers drilldown
- billing mismatch if our cost rollups don't align with billing system

frank: mitigations:
- default hard cap per-tenant on ingest and automatic reject when cap hit
- pre-aggregated cost vectors per-10m window written to the metrics store
- reconciliation job to compare rollups to billing daily (accept within 12%)

ravi: acceptance tests:
- traffic replay at 3x normal, confirm sampling stays within budget and traces are present
- fault injection to trigger error clusters and verify alert + example trace
- cost-delta simulation to validate alerting path and webhook notifications

jen: owners:
- ash: sampling + edge config + caps
- ravi: cost rollups + reconciliation job
- nina: dashboard UX + pilot onboarding
- jen: error clustering + alerting templates
- frank: product lead + launch decision

frank: rough timeline:
week1: edge sampling + caps, basic ingest
week2: cost rollup job + reconciliation prototype
week3: UI cards + drilldown + sample trace view
week4: pilot rollout + alert tests
week5: polish + docs + launch window

nina: must-cuts if behind:
- remove model rollup and keep route-only cost
- limit trace drilldown to errors-only samples
- reduce retention of traces to 24h for MVP

ash: small config snippet for edge agent (for visibility):
```yaml
agent_sampling:
  baseline: 0.01
  tail_ms: 300
  error_sample: 1.0
  per_tenant_cap: 500000 # spans/day
```

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging/console-observe-compact @ 2024-06-12T10:00:00Z

frank: please comment by EOD Thu if any owner not confident. i'll fold this into a trimmed spec after owners ack. thanks everyone :shipit:
